Confusion matrix between two label columns

Source: R/model_training.R
label_confusion_matrix.Rd

Builds a confusion matrix comparing two label columns in `colData(spe)`, with aligned levels so missing categories are represented.

Usage

label_confusion_matrix(spe, label_col1, label_col2, drop_na = TRUE)

Arguments

spe

A `SpatialExperiment`/`SingleCellExperiment`.

label_col1

First label column name.

label_col2

Second label column name.

drop_na

Logical; if TRUE, rows with NA in either label are dropped. Default TRUE.

Value

A table with rows = `label_col1` levels and columns = `label_col2` levels.

Examples

data("cytoGateR_example", package = "cytoGateR")
label_confusion_matrix(
  cytoGateR_example,
  "cell_type_hard",
  "knn_label"
)
